key_insight: Jianmu-Q uses specialized AI agents to convert natural-language quantum field theory descriptions into validated quantum simulation workflows that bridge theory, lattice models, and hardware-ready circuits.
engineering_relevance: The framework lowers the expertise barrier for building quantum simulations of field theories and provides a structured path from model specification to execution on quantum hardware.
method: Agent-based workflow for theory formulation, lattice discretization, qubit mapping, and circuit design
Physical-consistency checks plus independent numerical validation at each stage
Benchmarked on NJL, Schwinger, and 2+1D Z2 gauge theory, with selected runs on IBM hardware
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that noiseless circuit simulations converge toward exact-diagonalization and tensor-network results across three benchmark field theories, with selected circuits also executed on IBM quantum hardware.
watch_item: Performance is demonstrated on a limited set of benchmark models, so robustness for larger, noisier, or more complex field theories remains to be established.
paper_title: Jianmu-Q: Bridging Quantum Field Theory and Quantum Hardware with AI Agents
